mapper.select: SELECT cg.id AS groupId, cg.name AS groupName, sm.id AS mapId, sm.name AS mapName, cg.visibility AS visibility, mm.role AS myRole, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS granted, p.created_at AS grantedAt FROM shared_map sm INNER JOIN campus_group cg ON cg.id = sm.group_id INNER JOIN map_member mm ON mm.map_id = sm.id AND mm.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN schedule_share_permission p ON p.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND p.target_type = 'GROUP' AND p.target_id = cg.id AND p.permission_level = 'FREE_BUSY' ORDER BY sm.updated_at DESC, sm.id DESC
